item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. New capabilities will open new industries, expand demand and create work we cannot yet imagine.

2. We see superintelligent AI as a job creator. If it arrives within the next 20 years, it will generate more jobs than it displaces. Our task is to prepare people for that expansion through education, training and opportunity.

3. We reject the idea that smarter machines mean less work for people. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We stand for helping workers seize those opportunities.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. By unlocking new capabilities, lowering barriers to building businesses and expanding what people can accomplish, it will generate new industries and new demand for human work. We recognise that this transformation will disrupt existing roles, and we refuse to leave affected workers behind. We want education, practical training and support that connect people to the opportunities ahead. Our commitment is clear: we will champion technological progress alongside investment in people, so that a growing world of work delivers opportunity across our communities.
